title: Qwen-MT-Lumen at WMT2026: Instruction-Specialized Translation via Quality-Aware Training and On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19758v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Lumen, The open-source model is available at, our submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation Shared Task. We focus on instruction-specialized translation, where systems must produce accurate translations while satisfying fine-grained requirements on style, terminology, and structured output. Lumen follows a four-stage pipeline. First, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning jointly strengthen multilingual translation competence and the ability to follow translation-specific instructions, such as terminology, style, and format constraints. Second, we extend the originally offline M^{2}PO preference-optimization framework into an online preference-optimization stage: the current policy samples candidate translations, an LLM judge assigns continuous direct-assessment scores, and the resulting multi-pair preferences are used to update the model. translated_title: Qwen-MT-Lumen 在 WMT2026：通过质量感知训练与在线策略蒸馏实现指令专业化翻译
translated_abstract: 我们提出 Lumen（开源模型已在...发布），这是我们提交给 WMT 2026 通用机器翻译共享任务的系统。我们专注于指令专业化翻译，即系统必须在生成准确译文的同时，满足对风格、术语和结构化输出的细粒度要求。Lumen 采用四阶段流水线：首先，持续预训练与监督微调共同增强多语言翻译能力以及遵循翻译特定指令（如术语、风格和格式约束）的能力；其次，我们将原本离线的 M²PO 偏好优化框架扩展为在线偏好优化阶段：由当前策略采样候选译文，由大模型评判器给出连续的直接评估分数，并利用由此产生的多对偏好来更新模型；第三，在线策略蒸馏将更强的翻译能力……（原文摘要在此处被截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 该论文提出面向 WMT 2026 的开源翻译系统 Lumen，通过持续预训练、监督微调、将离线 M²PO 扩展为带 LLM 评判打分的在线偏好优化、以及在线策略蒸馏的四阶段流水线，实现同时满足风格、术语与结构化输出等细粒度指令要求的高质量翻译。
en_tdlr: Lumen, an open-source submission to WMT 2026, achieves instruction-specialized translation via a four-stage pipeline combining continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, online M²PO preference optimization with LLM-judged continuous scores, and on-policy distillation.
